# Mastermind Academy

> Mastermind Academy is a coaching institute in Nehru Nagar, Belagavi, Karnataka, offering Spoken English classes (online and offline), Interview Mastery with Personality Development, Class 6 to 10 school tuition for CBSE, ICSE, KVS and State Board, and academic coaching for B.E, BCA and Diploma students.

Tagline: Learn · Practice · Excel (Education Hub for a Brighter Future)
Location: Nehru Nagar, Belagavi, Karnataka 590010
Areas Served: Nehru Nagar, Belagavi and nearby areas
Phone / WhatsApp: 90194 16236, 81239 50627
Lecturers: Laxmi (B.E), Pooja (B.E)

## About Mastermind Academy
Mastermind Academy is a learning centre in Nehru Nagar, Belagavi, built around one simple idea: students learn best when they practise, not just listen. Our classes are small and personal. Every student gets attention, every doubt gets answered, and every session gives them a chance to speak, write and think for themselves. Whether a child is struggling with a school subject or a graduate is nervous about a first interview, we work at their pace until they feel ready.

### Teaching Approach
- Learn: Clear concepts explained in simple language.
- Practice: Regular speaking, writing and revision, so nothing stays theoretical.
- Excel: The confidence to perform in exams, interviews and everyday life.

## Programs in Detail

### Spoken English Classes (Online and Offline)
URL: /spoken-english-classes-belagavi
Summary: Separate, structured batches for Kids (Offline, 2 months), Beginners / Intermediate (Online and Offline, 2 to 3 months) and Advanced learners (Online and Offline, 2 to 3 months).
Batches:
- Kids Batch: Offline (Nehru Nagar, Belagavi), 2 months. Vocabulary, clear pronunciation and speaking without fear in a friendly classroom.
- Beginners / Intermediate: Online and Offline, 2 to 3 months. Daily-use grammar, sentence building, fluency and comfortable everyday conversation.
- Advanced Level: Online and Offline, 2 to 3 months. Fluent expression, sharp communication and confident speaking at college, work and in public.

### Interview Mastery with Personality Development
URL: /interview-mastery-personality-development-belagavi
Duration: 2 months
Mode: Practical classroom coaching in Nehru Nagar, Belagavi
Topics covered:
- Self-introduction and answering common interview questions
- Body language, voice and eye contact
- Communication and presentation skills
- Group discussion and mock interviews
- Grooming, etiquette and confidence building

### School Tuition, 6th to 10th (CBSE, ICSE, KVS, State Board)
URL: /school-tuition-classes-6-to-10-belagavi
Summary: Subject guidance for students of CBSE, ICSE, KVS and State Board. We help students build strong basics, finish their syllabus on time and prepare calmly for exams.
Boards taught: CBSE, ICSE, KVS, State Board

### Classes for B.E, BCA and Diploma Students
URL: /be-bca-diploma-classes-belagavi
Summary: Academic support and communication coaching for college students pursuing B.E, BCA and Diploma courses, taught by qualified B.E graduate lecturers.

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Who can join the Spoken English course?
A: Anyone. At Mastermind Academy in Belagavi, we have separate batches for kids, beginners/intermediate learners and advanced learners so every student practises with peers at a similar comfort level.

Q: Are online classes available?
A: Yes, online Spoken English classes are available for Beginners/Intermediate and Advanced levels across Belagavi and Karnataka. The Kids batch is offline only at our Nehru Nagar, Belagavi centre.

Q: How long are the courses?
A: Spoken English runs 2 to 3 months depending on the level (2 months for Kids, and 2 to 3 months for Beginners/Intermediate and Advanced), and Interview Mastery with Personality Development runs 2 months.

Q: Do you teach all school boards?
A: Yes. Mastermind Academy in Nehru Nagar, Belagavi provides school tuition for CBSE, ICSE, KVS and State Board for classes 6 to 10.

Q: How do I enrol or ask about fees?
A: Call us on 90194 16236 or 81239 50627, message us on WhatsApp, or visit Mastermind Academy in Nehru Nagar, Belagavi, Karnataka 590010.
